name: @cognia/agent-orchestration
description: Cognia multi-agent orchestration core (ADR-0217): durable Agent Team run records, the TeamRunStore port with a reference in-memory store and its conformance contract, the durable coordinator (admission, fair scheduling, leases, steering, pause and recovery) behind run-journal, redaction, path-policy, remote-session and child-control ports, the decision and evidence ledgers, and replay-safety and attempt-fencing rules. No host code.
